backup_desc: Create secure backups of your data to ensure safety and peace of mind.

font_desc: Customize your reading experience. Change font size and style with ease. 🔠✨
data_backup_desc: Experience the reliability of Data Backup, ensuring the protection of your valuable information. Safeguard your data from potential loss and have the ability to restore it quickly when needed.
data_sync_desc: Experience the convenience of data synchronization for seamless data transfer between your devices. Stay connected and updated across multiple platforms with the data sync feature.
data_secure_desc: Your data is in safe hands with our cutting-edge security measures. We use advanced encryption algorithms to ensure that your information remains confidential and inaccessible to unauthorized users. Your privacy is of the utmost importance to us, and we take every precaution to safeguard your data during backup and synchronization. Trust our app to keep your valuable information secure, so you can focus on what matters most without worries about data security.
font_size_placeholder: Jesus saves sinners with His amazing grace, filling our hearts with joy and hope, as we walk in faith and trust in Him throughout our journey.
midi_cache_desc: Render the next songs in the background
midi_neighbor_desc: How many neighboring songs are rendered early
offline_library_desc: Manage encrypted Bible and hymnal assets, check the latest GitHub releases, remove installed assets, and clear fast caches from one dedicated page.
bible_section_desc: TB stays bundled. Other versions are downloaded from public GitHub Releases without sign-in and installed for offline reading.
hymnal_section_desc: KR stays bundled. Other hymnals are downloaded encrypted and can only be opened inside this app.
soundfont_section_desc: TimGM6mb stays bundled. Other SoundFonts are downloaded from GitHub Releases for better instrument quality.
delete_app_cache_desc: Removes fast-access PDF prep, PDF note cache, MIDI render cache, and leftover temporary packages. Installed Bibles and hymnals are preserved.
full_app_reset_desc: Wipes everything from this device and returns to the first-launch setup. Removes downloaded assets, notes, reminders, login state, cache, and preferences.
